title: High
html_source:
internal narrative

Joyce confirms the inconsequential nature of Lambert’s blurt: bladderbags = gobshite ! Not to mention the rather in rather upsets a man’s day, a funeral does. This is a wonderfully subtle example of Bloom’s pragmatic but also wholesome nature. We have previously read his efficient digestion of graveyard planning and efficacy yet Leopold can identify an insincere chancer when he sees one.

 He ate off the crescent of water biscuit he had been nibbling and, hungered, made ready to nibble the biscuit in his other hand.
